# Clavis Encrypt 3.11.4

## 🛠️ Safer saving

- Your vault and settings are now saved in one step: Clavis writes the new version first and only then swaps it in. A crash, a power cut or a USB stick pulled out at the wrong moment can no longer leave them empty or damaged.

## 💾 Large files on USB sticks

- Many USB sticks use FAT32, which can't hold files of 4 GB or more. Clavis now checks before it starts and tells you plainly, instead of failing part-way through.

## Install / upgrade

- **Windows, already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now), or download the new installer from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.
- **Microsoft Store:** the Store updates it automatically.
- **Linux:** install the new `.deb` from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
